Belgrave ladies placed highly in the Surrey Ladies Cross Country League league as individuals this winter. Wendy Cotterell was first Senior with Jacintha Coppinger third, and in the Junior ranks Jacqui Smiter was third.
Jacqui Smiter is one of the mainstays of the Ladies team. Always willing to help out she competed in no less than seven events in one early season track and field fixture.
Above: Jacqui Smiter (left) and Jackie Stone (right) receive the Endeavour Cup from Harry Porter and Derek Jones. Opposite page: Jessica Dash, winner of the Frank Simmons Cup.
